stages.discovery: A body hangs from a low branch at the edge of the road, turning slow in whatever wind finds its way through the canopy. A crude sign is lashed around the neck below the rope: a warning, not a name. Whoever did this wanted it seen, not hidden.

choices.label: Cut Them Down
choices.description: No one deserves to be left as a message
choices.outcome: You cut the rope and lay the body in the roadside brush, out of sight of the path at least. It's not a burial, but it's not a warning sign anymore either.

choices.label: Read the Sign
choices.description: See what it says, and who left it - Investigation check

check.success_outcome: The words are rough-carved but plain enough: a toll unpaid, a debt made an example of. Whoever controls this stretch of road wants travelers to know the price of refusing them.
check.failure_outcome: The carving's too crude and weather-worn to make out more than a few threatening words, nothing you can piece into a full warning.

choices.label: Hurry Past
choices.description: ESC also cancels - the message wasn't meant for you, and you'd rather keep it that way
choices.outcome: You quicken your pace and don't slow down again until the tree is well behind you.
